mini_lesson.simple_intro: Nahw is the science that teaches us how to make correct Arabic sentences. It shows us how to put words together right.
step_by_step_explanation: Nahw helps us join nouns, verbs, and particles to make sentences.
It teaches us about the last letter of words and how it should be.
The main things in Nahw are words and sentences.

think_about_it.question: Why do we need to learn Nahw?
think_about_it.hint: Think about how it helps us speak Arabic.
think_about_it.answer: We learn Nahw to speak, read, and write Arabic correctly.

try_it_yourself.task: Try to make a simple sentence using دَخَلَ, دَار, زَيْد, and فِي.
try_it_yourself.simple_reason: We put the words together to make a correct sentence.

tiny_recap: Nahw teaches us to make correct Arabic sentences.
It helps us use Arabic words the right way.

key_terms.simple_explanation: The science that teaches us to make correct Arabic sentences.
key_terms.example_from_text: Nahw is that science, which teaches us how to join a noun, verb and particle to form a correct sentence.

key_terms.simple_explanation: The condition of the last letter of a word.
key_terms.example_from_text: what the إِعْرَابٌ (condition) of the last letter of a word should be.

flashcards.back: The science that teaches us to make correct Arabic sentences.
The condition of the last letter of a word.

quiz.question: Nahw helps us understand the Qur'an better.
quiz.simple_explanation: Nahw teaches us Arabic, which helps us understand the Qur'an.

mini_lesson.simple_intro: A word in Arabic can be meaningful or meaningless. Meaningful words are either singular or compound.
step_by_step_explanation: A لَفْظٌ مَوْضُوعٌ is a word with meaning.
A لَفْظٌ مُهْمَلٌ is a word without meaning.
There are two types of لَفْظٌ مَوْضُوعٌ: مُفْرَدٌ (singular) and مُرَكَّبٌ (compound).
There are three types of كَلِمَةٌ: اِسْمٌ (noun), فِعْلٌ (verb), and حَرْفٌ (particle).

think_about_it.question: Can you think of a مُفْرَدٌ word?
think_about_it.hint: Think of a single word that means something.

try_it_yourself.task: Identify if رَجُلٌ is a مُفْرَدٌ or مُرَكَّبٌ.
try_it_yourself.simple_reason: رَجُلٌ is a single word that means 'man'.

common_mistake.correction: Words can be مُفْرَدٌ or مُرَكَّبٌ. Check if it's a single word or a group of words.

tiny_recap: There are مُفْرَدٌ and مُرَكَّبٌ words.
There are three types of كَلِمَةٌ: اِسْمٌ, فِعْلٌ, and حَرْفٌ.

key_terms.example_from_text: Any word uttered by humans is called a لَفْظٌ. If it has a meaning, it is called مَوْضُوعٌ (meaningful).

key_terms.simple_explanation: A word that names a person, place, or thing.
key_terms.example_from_text: It is the name of a person, place or thing.

key_terms.simple_explanation: A word that shows an action.
A word that needs other words to have meaning.
key_terms.example_from_text: It is that كَلِمَةٌ whose meaning cannot be understood without joining an اِسْمٌ or a فِعْلٌ or both to it.

flashcards.back: A single word that means something.
A word that names a person, place, or thing.

quiz.question: What is a مُفْرَدٌ?
quiz.simple_explanation: A مُفْرَدٌ is a single word that means something.

quiz.question: A حَرْفٌ needs other words to have meaning.
quiz.simple_explanation: A حَرْفٌ cannot stand alone and needs other words.

exercise_answers.question: State with reason whether the following words are حَرْفٌ or فِعْلٌ ، اِسْمٌ.
exercise_answers.answer: i. جَلَسَ (He sat.) is a فِعْلٌ because it shows an action. ii. وَ (and) is a حَرْفٌ because it needs other words to have meaning. iii. بِنْتٌ (girl) is an اِسْمٌ because it names something. iv. كَسَرَ (He broke.) is a فِعْلٌ because it shows an action.
exercise_answers.reason: We check if the word shows an action, names something, or needs other words to have meaning.

exercise_answers.question: Find the meaning and the plural of the following nouns using a dictionary.
exercise_answers.answer: i. قَلَمٌ means 'pen' and the plural is أَقْلامٌ. ii. فَصْلٌ means 'season' and the plural is فُصُولٌ. iii. كِتَابٌ means 'book' and the plural is كُتُبٌ. iv. سَبُورَةٌ means 'blackboard' and the plural is سُبُورٌ.
exercise_answers.reason: We look up each noun in a dictionary to find its meaning and plural.
